tools.name: preview_scope
tools.description: List the requested channels the user can already access, the period, and a message count. Do not copy message text.

tools.name: confirm_scope
tools.description: Record the requesting user's confirmation of the exact channel ids and the period. This does not post and does not approve monitoring.

tools.name: produce_digest
tools.description: Return a read-only digest of the confirmed channels and period. Every point quotes a source message.
